standard_prerequisites.use: The first makes the pulled back module universally pure, the constructibility statement makes the set of points where the associated points of the fibre lie in the image of the etale morphism constructible, and the criterion converts that inclusion into purity, which is how the open neighbourhood is produced.

standard_prerequisites.name: A constructible set containing the spectrum of the local ring at a point contains an open neighbourhood, and the image of an open subset under an etale morphism is open
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the containment of the local spectrum in the constructible set into an open neighbourhood of the point, whose image in the base is the desired open set of points of purity.

core_obligations: Produce the affine etale neighbourhood: for a point s at which the module is pure along the fibre, use the flat along the fibre lemma to find an elementary etale neighbourhood and an etale morphism from an affine scheme whose image contains the fibre and whose global sections of the pulled back module are projective over the ring of the base (proof lines 5500-5513).

Apply purity and constructibility: the pulled back module is universally pure over the new base, so by the purity criterion the spectrum of the local ring at the lifted point of the base is contained in the set of points where the associated points of the fibre lie in the image W' of the etale morphism; that set is constructible by the constructibility statement for the relative assassin (proof lines 5514-5530).

Conclude openness: a constructible set containing the spectrum of the local ring at a point contains an open neighbourhood of that point, and applying the criterion once more shows that for every point in the image of that neighbourhood the module is pure along the fibre; since the morphism to the base is etale, that image is open, which proves the statement (proof lines 5531-5535).
proof_roadmap: Build the affine etale neighbourhood with projective global sections (proof lines 5500-5513).
Purity plus constructibility gives a constructible set containing the local spectrum (proof lines 5514-5530).
Enlarge to an open neighbourhood and push it to the base (proof lines 5531-5535).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the set of points of the base over which a finitely presented module flat over the base is pure along the fibre is open (statement lines 5489-5498, tag 05MC). The proof is a real etale local argument: it builds the affine etale neighbourhood with projective global sections, observes that the pulled back module is universally pure, uses the purity criterion and the constructibility of the relative assassin condition to produce a constructible set containing the spectrum of the local ring at the lifted point, and then converts that into an open neighbourhood whose image in the base is the required open set. The constructibility step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
